marketing_description: The Philips LED Filament Bulb, part number 573378, offers 800 lumens of soft white light with a color temperature of 2700 K and a color rendering index of 90. This 8.8 W bulb is a dimmable option with a medium E26 base and is equivalent to a 60 W incandescent bulb. It has an average life of 15000 hours and operates at a voltage rating of 120 V.
